_comment: Per-project config for the pr-check skill. Copy to .claude/pr-check.json in the consuming repo and adjust. This example is the wiki-polis (Flask v2 + React SPA) binding.
_scope_comment: The UI now lives in v2/frontend/src as .tsx, not in v2/templates as Jinja. Scope globs are listed in both fnmatch ('*' crosses '/') and pathlib ('**') forms so the SPA is matched whichever way the skill globs; without a glob that reaches v2/frontend/src a React-only PR matched no scope at all and drew senior-engineer alone — no accessibility or usability reviewer on the entire user-facing surface.
test_command: cd v2 && DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///:memory:" SECRET_KEY="00000000000000000000000000000000" FLASK_DEBUG=1 uv run pytest -q
